basic_info.description: $207K price reduction!!! Move-in to one unit; rent out the other! 2-unit property conveniently located on  the border of the Sunnyside/Glen Park neighborhoods. One unit now vacant. VIEWS of hills from upper unit! Both units have updated kitchens & bathrooms; high ceilings.The lower unit has 2BR/1BA; Upper unit has 2BR/1BA & bonus 1BR/small half-bath. Both units have washer/dryers and direct access to the shared deck/landscaped backyard. Both units are tenant-occupied. Parking pad in front. Healthy cash flow for investors! The duplex is a houses away to the historic, octagonal Sunnyside Conservatory, now a public park. Convenient location: easy access to freeways; close to West Portal & Glen Park villages, Stonestown, Muni lines & BART stations.
